validity: Exact shipping cnt-rust memchr shim and raw_slice helper, original core_rs::mem module, genuine CRT memchr.c. One non-null initialized byte region of n bytes, left- and right-aligned against inaccessible pages. n=0 performs no access. Signed-char comparison against the untruncated int c is intentional; values outside -128..127 never match. Positive matches supplied by zero/255/ascending/descending patterns. Returned pointer must be null or inside the searched range, never one past. Host-only selected-body grade.

mutants.name: read_past_end
mutants.find: let s_s = raw_slice(s as *const u8, n);
mutants.replace: let s_s = raw_slice(s as *const u8, n + 1);

mutants.name: read_before_start
mutants.find: let s_s = raw_slice(s as *const u8, n);
mutants.replace: core::ptr::read_volatile((s as *const u8).sub(1)); let s_s = raw_slice(s as *const u8, n);
